title: BEACH Brave Souls - 3D Action
notes: Game shows logo and then goes black with anime audio. After a few seconds, you can skip the video (don't know if this can be fixed?) able to get in-game but controls are wonky as this is clearly mobile game shovelware pushed onto Steam (sorry Bleach fans) so you have to use the mouse for certain things (thinking your gamepad isn't working) and then when you get in-game you have full control using a gamepad (only to have to "touch" the screen using a mouse when dialog shows up - it's a really poor experience) I tried to reproduce the black video issue but it turns out the game doesn't even bother showing the video again once you've started. I didn't see a way in the menus to see it again. other than being curious how to deal with black video issues, I don't think this game is worth anyone's time! (ok I'm done ranting) game log is minimal [2026-10-05T195238Z-Games-steam.exe.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33075629/2026-10-05T195238Z-Games-steam.exe.log)
